يستقصيا (form X)
# يَسْتَقْصِيَا (yastaqṣiyā) /jas.taq.sˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# يُسْتَقْصَيَا (yustaqṣayā) /jus.taq.sˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
